--- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [Graph.add_complete_multipartite_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | Edgecase description: Add a complete multipartite graph to the current graph. twitter-card: title: >- [Graph.add_complete_multipartite_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | Edgecase description: Add a complete multipartite graph to the current graph. title: >- [Graph.add_complete_multipartite_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: Add a complete multipartite graph to the current graph. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a complete multipartite graph to the current graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7360-L7458){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature Graph.add_complete_multipartite_graph( sizes, type=None, label=True, rel=None, part_attr="part", ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Complete multipartite graph](../assets/graphs/add-complete-multipartite-graph.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Three complete multipartite graphs on a ring of six nodes, each part in its own color: sizes 1, 2, 3; sizes 2, 2, 2 (the octahedron); and sizes 1, 1, 2, 2. Two nodes are joined exactly when they belong to different parts, so the only missing pairs are inside a part." width="100%"} Creates one group of nodes per entry of `sizes=` and joins every pair of nodes that lie in different groups. Nodes in the same group are never joined, so each group is an independent set and the graph's chromatic number equals the number of non-empty groups. Each node's group index (`0`, `1`, ...) is stored in the `part_attr=` node attribute. The groups are created in order, each as a consecutive run of node IDs. In a directed graph every edge points from the earlier-created node to the later one. The graph is appended without touching or connecting to existing nodes, and the whole construction is recorded as a single step. Complete multipartite graphs include several familiar families: - two groups give the complete bipartite graph (see `add_complete_bipartite_graph()`) - groups of size `1` give the complete graph, and `n` groups of size `2` give the cocktail-party graph (`[2, 2, 2]` is the octahedron) - as equal as possible group sizes give the Turán graph (see `add_turan_graph()`) They are handy for modeling "everyone except your own team" relations (round-robin matches between clubs, cross-department review) and for testing coloring and independent-set algorithms. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [sizes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of nodes in each group, e.g. `[2, 3, 4]`. Every size must be non-negative. [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional value stored in the `type` attribute of every new node. If `None` (default), no `type` attribute is set. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True` (default), each new node is labelled with its node ID as a string; a label that is already used raises `ValueError` before anything is added. If `False`, the nodes are left unlabelled. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional value stored in the `rel` attribute of every new edge. If `None` (default), no `rel` attribute is set. [part_attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["part"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the node attribute that records each node's group index. Default is `"part"`. Pass `None` to skip storing it. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. The graph is modified in place. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any entry of `sizes=` is negative. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} With groups of `1`, `2`, and `3` nodes, each node is joined to every node outside its own group, giving `1*2 + 1*3 + 2*3 = 11` edges: ::: {#feab2fa1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_complete_multipartite_graph(sizes=[1, 2, 3]) graph.count_nodes(), graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (6, 11) ``` ::: ::: A node's degree is the number of nodes outside its group: ::: {#5825f8de .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.get_node_df().select("label", "part", "degree") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
